title: Securing Pimicotinib Approval: How Abbisko Therapeutics Successfully Completed its NMPA and FDA Submissions with Pinnacle 21 Enterprise
summary: Learn how Abbisko Therapeutics improved regulatory readiness and accelerated its path to submission readiness, securing FDA NDA acceptance.

By adopting Pinnacle 21® Enterprise (P21E), Abbisko Therapeutics accelerated its path to pimicotinib approval, completing its NMPA submission and securing Bijieermai FDA NDA acceptance from the FDA.

[Abbisko Therapeutics Co., Ltd](https://www.abbisko.com/) . is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the research, discovery, and development of innovative and differentiated medicines that address unmet medical needs of patients in China and around the world. Focused on small molecule drugs, Abbisko has built deep expertise in targeted tumor therapy and tumor immunotherapy, with a growing pipeline spanning early discovery through regulatory submission.


Pimicotinib (marketed in China as Bijieermai®) is a new oral CSF-1R inhibitor discovered and developed by Abbisko. The drug is used to treat tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT), a rare and often debilitating tumor of the joints and tendons. Pimicotinib is licensed to Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany for worldwide commercialization.


This case study shares Abbisko Therapeutics’ experience adopting[Pinnacle 21® Enterprise](https://www.certara.com/pinnacle-21-enterprise-software/validation/) (P21E) to strengthen its clinical data compliance and regulatory review processes when seeking pimicotinib[FDA](https://www.fda.gov/) approval.


## Key factors in gaining pimicotinib approval


As Abbisko worked toward pimicotinib approval, its clinical pipeline grew, and the statistical programming team needed a way to raise the bar on regulatory readiness across every study. The team’s priorities were to:


- Achieve end-to-end compliance control and a comprehensive upgrade of data quality
- Proactively identify and manage submission risks to improve project success rates
- Reduce cost and improve efficiency to:


- accelerate R&D
- speed products to market


- Strengthen full lifecycle data management to build long-term industry competitiveness


## Achieving regulatory compliance with Pinnacle 21 Enterprise


Since May 2024, Abbisko has deployed Pinnacle 21 Enterprise to optimize and streamline its internal regulatory review system, building on a long-term, stable collaboration with Certara and Tri-I Biotech.


The platform has helped the team validate data quality and[comply with CDISC standards](https://www.certara.com/blog/a-guide-to-cdisc-standards-used-in-clinical-research/) , establishing itself as a high-quality, efficient channel for submitting data to regulatory authorities – including its NMPA submission for pimicotinib.


“P21E fully empowers clinical data compliance management and the entire regulatory submission process, providing strong support for the efficient advancement and regulatory compliance of our R&D projects,” said the Statistical Programming Lead at Abbisko Therapeutics.


Their implementation of Enterprise was a smooth process, backed by professional training and responsive support from the P21E Certara team. The management team added:


“The training was very professional, and the communication and feedback were also very timely.”


## How Pinnacle 21 Enterprise facilitated Pimicotinib approval and FDA NDA acceptance


With Pinnacle 21 Enterprise embedded in its clinical programming workflow, Abbisko has achieved a comprehensive upgrade across its clinical R&D data management and submission processes. This support has helped the team achieve pimicotinib approval through both pimicotinib NMPA approval and pimicotinib FDA approval, culminating in Bijieermai FDA NDA acceptance.


The platform also helped Abbisko support its multinational partner in completing pimicotinib’s global out-licensing, and continues to help the company accelerate the launch of new products.


### Key impacts:


- Successful pimicotinib NMPA approval (also known as pimicotinib China approval) and Bijieermai FDA NDA acceptance
- Supported global out-licensing to its multinational pharmaceutical partner
- Comprehensive upgrade in clinical R&D data management and submission processes
- A single, standardized channel for regulatory submissions, validated for data quality and CDISC compliance
- Faster, more confident regulatory reviews, helping accelerate the launch of new products


“After implementing the Pinnacle 21 Enterprise platform, Abbisko Therapeutics achieved a comprehensive upgrade in its clinical R&D data management and submission processes,” the management team said.

## FAQs


### What is pimicotinib approval?


Pimicotinib approval refers to regulatory clearance for pimicotinib, an oral CSF-1R inhibitor for adult patients with symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT).


### What does Bijieermai FDA NDA acceptance mean for the pimicotinib FDA approval process?


Bijieermai FDA NDA acceptance means the FDA has confirmed pimicotinib’s New Drug Application is complete enough for formal review. This is an important step toward full pimicotinib FDA approval. Acceptance is not the same as approval; the FDA will now conduct a substantive review of clinical and manufacturing data before reaching a decision.


### What is the difference between pimicotinib NMPA approval (pimicotinib China approval) and pimicotinib FDA approval?


Pimicotinib NMPA approval, also known as pimicotinib China approval, was granted in December 2025 for adult TGCT patients in China. Pimicotinib FDA approval is a separate process still underway in the U.S., following FDA acceptance of the NDA. Each regulator applies its own review timelines and data standards.


### Why is CDISC compliance important for an NMPA submission?


[CDISC standards](https://www.certara.com/guide/the-complete-guide-to-cdisc-standards-management/) ensure clinical trial data is structured consistently, making it easier for regulators to review and validate submitted datasets during an NMPA submission. Non-compliant data can trigger delays or added queries, so[validating compliance early](https://www.certara.com/blog/how-to-validate-your-clinical-data-using-fda-validation-rules/) supports a smoother regulatory pathway across markets.


### How long does pimicotinib approval typically take after FDA NDA acceptance?


Standard FDA review is about 10 months from acceptance, while Priority Review can shorten timelines to around 6 months. Breakthrough Therapy Designation, which pimicotinib has received, does not guarantee a faster review but can accelerate the overall pimicotinib approval timeline.
